facts.fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation signed a project document on 4 May 2026 with UNDP, supported by the Government of Japan, titled 'Support to implementing the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030'; it states no domestic allocation.

The minister-High Commissioner for Digitalisation signed the project to carry out the strategy and said she is supporting preparation and implementation of its executive plan for 2027-2030, focused on the fourth axis (digital economy).
The minister said the implementation plan for 2025-2026 has been prepared and is under way, with an executive plan for 2027-2030 being prepared; no cost is stated.
The project title and minister give the strategy the period 2025-2030; the article does not say the text is public (as-at 2026-05-04).
